title: DaVinci Hydrotube
description:
This Hydrotube is made from high-strength borosilicate glass. By adding water, this patented design will cool down vapor with its elongated path, plus it’s spill proof so you can confidently throw it in your bag and go. It fits any 10mm ground glass male joint.

Compatible with DAVINCI IQ, IQ2, IQ2 Carbon, IQC, MIQRO, MIQRO-C and ARTIQ.
